definition: Potsherd — the vessel of the offering (udaka, water) poured for the poet who surpassed the speaker. The poem's namesake: the work names itself at its close. Both literal vessel and metaphor for the poem itself.

sources.claim: tasmai vaheyam udakaṃ ghaṭakarpareṇa (to him I pour water in ghaṭakarpara)

translations.note: 'Potsherd' is the standard; 'broken pot' emphasizes the fracture.
